description: A `type` or `interface` describing the props object, used to annotate the component's parameter.
Everything React can render: elements, strings, numbers, arrays, fragments, portals, `null`, `undefined`, booleans. The usual type for `children`.
`'info' | 'warning'`: a string restricted to a fixed set of values.
Legacy-style component type. Once added implicit `children`; plain functions with typed props are preferred.
`subtitle?: string` means the prop may be omitted; its type inside is `string | undefined` unless you give a default.
